standard_prerequisites: the WAdm^count category and the ideals of topologically nilpotent elements
formal spectra and their reduced closed subschemes
etale charts of affine formal algebraic spaces and etaleness of the induced maps on reductions
locality on source and target in the etale topology for locally finite type morphisms
core_obligations: Prove that the property that the induced map on reductions of formal spectra is locally of finite type satisfies the three clauses of the local property situation: propagation along etale maps, descent from a surjective etale chart, and closure under finite coproducts
proof_roadmap: Take the standard commutative diagram of the situation and form the Spf diagram, whose horizontal arrows are representable and etale by the formal spaces lemma
Pass to reduced formal spectra: the horizontal arrows remain etale by the reduction-smooth lemma
The three clauses of the situation translate into the three statements about locally finite type morphisms of the reduced schemes
The first two hold because locally finite type is local on source and target in the etale topology; the third is immediate from the definition of coproducts
